capabilities: record physical assessments with custom dates and optional measurements
browse and compare previous assessments to see changes
store assessments as Markdown files with frontmatter properties and notes
disambiguation: Not a workout-tracking app; it only records physical assessments and body measurements and complements dedicated workout-tracking applications.
extras: Version 0.1.0 under active development; not yet in the community plugin directory, so manual installation into .obsidian/plugins is required. Includes a medical disclaimer and English plus Brazilian Portuguese interface.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log body measurements and fitness assessments or compare and visualize them over time.
summary: Offline-first tracker that records physical assessments and body measurements as Markdown files and charts progress over time.
